# [pixi](../../../index.md) [workspace](../../index.md) [activation](../index.md) env

Commands to manage the `activation.env` table

## Usage
```
pixi workspace activation env <COMMAND>
```

## Subcommands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`set`](set.md) | Set (add or overwrite) activation environment variable(s) |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Remove activation environment variable(s) by name |
| [`list`](list.md) | List the activation environment variables in the manifest |
